name: OverdraftAssessmentCompleted
trigger: SVC-012 completes credit bureau refresh and 12-month behavioural analysis for the account. Publishes assessment results including credit grade, affordability score, and behavioural metrics.
journey_phase_name: Credit Bureau Refresh and Behavioural Analysis
capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-004 (SVC-012); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) for review decision. Crosses CAP-004 -> CAP-001.

payload_schema.credit_grade: string enum (A | B | C | D | E | F)
payload_schema.adverse_data_flags: array of string — CCJ, IVA, bankruptcy flags from bureau

derived_from.note: SVC-012 does not own a persistent entity for this assessment. Results are computed and published as an event. SVC-001 persists them on ENT-054.

consumers.action: Updates OverdraftReview (ENT-054) with assessment results. Proceeds to persistent debt screening (PH-085). If assessment_status = bureau_unavailable, defers review by 7 days.
Records credit assessment for audit trail.

ordering_guarantees: Per-account ordering. Always follows EVT-114 for the same review_id.
worm_rationale: Credit assessment is audit evidence for overdraft affordability assessment (FCA CONC 5A). Must be retained to demonstrate the bank conducted a proper affordability check before renewing/modifying the facility.
